title: Same scene, two renderers.
description: The homepage care-thread scene, from the clinic to home, as most devices draw it and as devices without a graphics processor draw it. Rooms and objects only, with no people.
notice: Local comparison only. Both films are recorded from the homepage scene; the homepage itself draws the scene live as you scroll.

detailsTitle: What differs — and what does not
details: Both films follow the homepage scroll path from the clinic consultation room to the living room at home.
Reduced quality draws at a lower pixel ratio. The homepage switches to it automatically when the browser reports a software (CPU) WebGL renderer.
The scene contains rooms, furniture, plants and the care thread only: no people, animals or faces.
The films were recorded locally with headless Chromium and encoded with ffmpeg. No paid tools or generated footage were used.
